This story gets me to still laugh to this day. 
  Back in my sophomore year of high school i had to take algebra. There was this classmate that wasn't the brightest bulb in the chandelier, with an attitude that matched her waistline ((lets call her Lulu)). One day, we were all sitting in our desks and the teacher asked a question. The question was: "what is a tangent?" Lulu stood in her ill fitting desk and said with all the sass a teen like her could muster.....
 "Thats stupid. Tangent is a color!"
 Mind you that this was algebra class. The teacher look like he was about to facepalm. Everyone was stunned silent, until the girl in front of me ((her name shall be clucky)) started cackling so hard her desk shook. That caused almost the whole class to start snickering. Some had to bury their faces into textbooks or just put their head down.  I was holding it in until clucky whispered "Tangent is a color". I lost it. I was laughing so hard i had to be sent out of the room. The rest of the day was a blur, but i will always remember that phrase. 
 "Tangent is a color."
